import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock
from virtua import PatientAppointment, WorkflowSystem, Chemist, Lab, MachineLearningAlgorithm

class TestPatientAppointment(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_patient_appointment_creation(self):
        patient_appointment = PatientAppointment("John Doe", "123 Main St")
        self.assertEqual(patient_appointment.patient_name, "John Doe")
        self.assertEqual(patient_appointment.address, "123 Main St")

    def test_workflow_system_routing(self):
        workflow_system = WorkflowSystem()
        chemist = Chemist("Chemist 1", "12345")
        lab = Lab("Lab 1", "67890")
        patient_appointment = PatientAppointment("John Doe", "123 Main St")
        patient_appointment.pincode = "12345"
        result = workflow_system.route_to_chemist(patient_appointment)
        self.assertTrue(result)

        patient_appointment.pincode = "67890"
        result = workflow_system.route_to_lab(patient_appointment)
        self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_machine_learning_algorithm_training(self):
        machine_learning_algorithm = MachineLearningAlgorithm()
        patient_appointment = PatientAppointment("John Doe", "123 Main St")
        patient_appointment.symptoms = ["fever", "cough"]
        machine_learning_algorithm.train(patient_appointment)
        self.assertEqual(machine_learning_algorithm.predicted_disease, "flu")

    def test_database_maintenance(self):
        database = Mock()
        administration = Mock()
        administration.maintain_database.return_value = None
        database.archive_patient.return_value = None
        patient_appointment = PatientAppointment("John Doe", "123 Main St")
        patient_appointment.consultation_date = "2022-01-01"
        administration.maintain_database(database)
        self.assertEqual(patient_appointment.consultation_date, "2022-01-01")

        patient_appointment.consultation_date = "2019-01-01"
        administration.maintain_database(database)
        self.assertEqual(patient_appointment.consultation_date, "2019-01-01")

    def test_archiving_criteria(self):
        database = Mock()
        administration = Mock()
        administration.maintain_database.return_value = None
        database.archive_patient.return_value = None
        patient_appointment = PatientAppointment("John Doe", "123 Main St")
        patient_appointment.consultation_date = "2019-01-01"
        administration.maintain_database(database)
        self.assertEqual(patient_appointment.consultation_date, "2019-01-01")

        patient_appointment.consultation_date = "2022-01-01"
        administration.maintain_database(database)
        self.assertEqual(patient_appointment.consultation_date, "2022-01-01")

    def test_consultation_request_generation(self):
        workflow_system = WorkflowSystem()
        patient_appointment = PatientAppointment("John Doe", "123 Main St")
        patient_appointment.pincode = "12345"
        result = workflow_system.generate_consultation_request(patient_appointment)
        self.assertEqual(result, 25000)

    def test_routing_failures(self):
        workflow_system = WorkflowSystem()
        chemist = Chemist("Chemist 1", "12345")
        lab = Lab("Lab 1", "67890")
        patient_appointment = PatientAppointment("John Doe", "123 Main St")
        patient_appointment.pincode = "99999"
        result = workflow_system.route_to_chemist(patient_appointment)
        self.assertFalse(result)

        patient_appointment.pincode = "99999"
        result = workflow_system.route_to_lab(patient_appointment)
        self.assertFalse(result)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
